class.name: wisco_ethercat_ros2_hw/SafeCommandController
class.description: Forwards Float64MultiArray commands on ~/commands to one command interface per joint, with a command timeout, per-joint magnitude limits, soft position limits, NaN rejection and a stop on deactivate.

class.name: wisco_ethercat_ros2_hw/ArmController
class.description: The arm's RT loop: Mode P (CSP target + 0x60B2 gravity/friction torque offset) and Mode T (CST host PD + feedforward), Pinocchio gravity from robot_description plus the calibration file, bumpless mode switching, and a 50 ms watchdog that drops to gravity comp + damping. Commands on ~/command, state on ~/state.

class.name: wisco_ethercat_ros2_hw/ParallelLinkageController
class.description: "PR mode" for parallel two-motor joints (ankles, waist): exports the serial joints' position / velocity / effort references and states, and drives the two motors of each mechanism through the CAD rod geometry (motor targets and per-motor gains for a PD-in-drive mode, or host-side joint PD as motor torques).

class.name: wisco_ethercat_ros2_hw/JointTargetController
class.description: A policy's joint targets (sensor_msgs/JointState by name) to the drives: hold on start, ramp in from the measured pose, clamp to the joint limits, the policy manifest's kp / kd per joint, and damp or hold when the targets stop arriving. Two-motor joints go through ParallelLinkageController's reference interfaces.

class.name: wisco_ethercat_ros2_hw/ChainedJointStateBroadcaster
class.description: /joint_states in the URDF's joints, reading the two-motor joints (ankles, waist) from ParallelLinkageController.
